posting.title: Head of Category – Grocery & FMCG
posting.location: Bengaluru (South region: Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad); full-time; relocation acceptable
must_have: 8-12 years in category management, buying or merchandising in grocery, FMCG, quick-commerce or e-commerce
Has owned a category P&L of meaningful size
Comfort with margin, pricing and inventory math
Experience negotiating with national FMCG brands and distributors
Hands-on with data: SQL or strong analyst partnership, dashboards, pricing benchmarks
Has built and run a team of 10+
Has worked closely with product/engineering on internal tools
nice_to_have: Experience launching a new city or region
company_language: hand in hand with product and supply chain
red_flags: No salary or compensation range listed
No posting date, so age cannot be verified
Very broad scope (P&L, assortment, pricing, suppliers, inventory, team building, tooling) across 3 cities and 40+ stores
'Thrives in speed' is vague and may signal high-pressure pace
Unclear reporting line and team size at start (expected to build and lead a team of category managers and analysts)
'Engineering background' and tools work blur the role's boundaries with product

matches.requirement: 8-12 years in category management, buying or merchandising in grocery, FMCG, quick-commerce or e-commerce
matches.suggestion: Lead with the category-management timeline: Ninjacart (2018-21), Fashinza, and Ninjacart FMCG & Grocery Director (2024-present). That is about 7+ years in category roles, plus 10+ years overall. Say so in the employer's words: 'category management across grocery, FMCG and agri-commerce'.

matches.requirement: Has owned a category P&L of meaningful size
matches.evidence: Managed P&L for key categories contributing 60% of revenue, driving 5x growth in daily volumes within 100 days.
matches.suggestion: Say 'Owned category P&L for categories contributing 60% of revenue.' Add the current Ninjacart FMCG & Grocery P&L size if you can share it, since the résumé gives no figure.

matches.requirement: Comfort with margin, pricing and inventory math
matches.evidence: End-to-end category management, product selection, market intelligence, pricing strategies, inventory optimization, P&L management, vendor negotiations, and retail strategy implementation.
matches.suggestion: Use their phrasing: 'pricing, margin and inventory optimization'. If you can, add a number showing a margin or inventory outcome.

matches.requirement: Experience negotiating with national FMCG brands and distributors
matches.evidence: vendor negotiations ... Cultivated strong relationships with key brands and sellers to ensure sustainable business growth across geographies.
matches.suggestion: Name the national FMCG brands and distributors you negotiate with at Ninjacart, and mention any joint business plans or terms you secured. 'Vendor negotiations' is too generic.

matches.requirement: Hands-on with data: SQL or strong analyst partnership, dashboards, pricing benchmarks
matches.evidence: conducting daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs ... Proficient in utilizing tools like Microsoft Office Suite, Figma, Tableau, AppsFlyer, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Amplitude, SQL
matches.suggestion: Highlight SQL, Tableau and daily price benchmarking together, and mirror their 'daily competitive benchmarking' wording.

matches.requirement: Has built and run a team of 10+
matches.evidence: Led cross-functional teams of over 250 members across layers.
matches.suggestion: Clarify how many direct reports and category managers you have built, so the team-building claim is clear alongside the 250-member cross-functional figure.

matches.requirement: Has worked closely with product/engineering on internal tools
matches.evidence: Worked closely with the tech and engineering teams and product managed the entire development and deployment of the seller and buyer facing applications.
matches.suggestion: Say 'partnered with product and engineering to build category and buying tools'. Note that the apps you built were seller- and buyer-facing, and add any internal tools if you built them.

matches.evidence: driving 5x growth in daily volumes within 100 days ... Drove online revenue market share from 8% to a commanding 55% in just 18 months
matches.suggestion: Frame these as fast-paced execution examples, using 'speed' language and quick-turnaround results.
Already based in Bengaluru. State it clearly in the header or summary, and mention openness to Chennai and Hyderabad travel since the role covers the South region.
Don't claim this. Mention adjacent experience such as daily price benchmarking and fast-moving perishable supply at Ninjacart, and be upfront that you have no dark-store experience.

matches.requirement: Experience launching a new city or region
matches.evidence: Led P&L optimization and market intelligence for 30+ cities, conducting daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs.
matches.suggestion: The résumé shows multi-city operations but not a launch. If you launched or scaled cities at Ninjacart Chennai, say so explicitly. Otherwise describe it as 'scaled across 30+ cities'.

matches.evidence: B.E. Computer Science ... Software Engineer, Accenture (Chennai)
matches.suggestion: Highlight the B.E. in Computer Science and three years as a software engineer at Accenture. It's a clear differentiator for this role.

I currently run the FMCG and Grocery vertical at Ninjacart and previously owned P&L for categories contributing 60% of revenue, with daily price benchmarking across 30+ cities. I'm Bengaluru-based and have a software engineering background. Would you be willing to refer me or point me to the right person?

Apply, and expect questions on those three.
